goal: Replace implicit default_board_viewer access with a least-privilege viewer role and an explicit owner-approved migration.
runtime_artifacts: Owner-approved manifests and reports belong under data/access-migrations/ and must not be committed or contain secrets in workflow reports.
acceptance: viewer exactly matches the former read-only branch scope and has no write capability.
The report lists every active roleless user, identifies technical-only users, and shows exact user and board/resource access deltas for each proposed choice.
The manifest requires an explicit viewer, customer, other-role, or no-role choice for every current roleless user and has no default.

Apply rechecks the complete roleless set and customer-open board ACL versions under the access lock, then changes user membership and board ACLs in one DB transaction with assignment and BoardAccessAudit records.
viewer is added without removing customer; conflict aborts the transaction and rollback uses the same canonical service.
After cutover, no role means no role-derived general access while approved technical authority remains unchanged.
New users receive no implicit role.
